CLOSING (operator-directed close-out, 2026-08-09) — this is a proposals LEDGER, and every approved proposal has landed under its own downstream ticket.

Verified present on origin/main at close time:
- BLOCK-verdict idempotent reuse — llm/plan_review/__init__.py:558 (bug 7e77).
- claim --review / edit --review — _commands/claim.py:24,32,87 and _commands/composer.py (story a114).
- Pass-1 usage on step output — plan_review/passes.py returns (findings, usage); surfaced via pass1.py/production_batch_runner.py (d52a).
- DET pre-gates for the zero-finding criteria — commit 49849ef0e5 (4ee2).
- genai-prices as an optional add-in — llm/usage_report.py.
- Pass-1 main-pool warm-then-fan-out — plan_review/pass1.py.
- G7 blocking at 0.85, T3/T5c/T10 at 0.90, and T1 web access — plan_review/criteria_routing.json (T1 web confirmed true).
- Mid-review cancellation — llm/workflow/plan_review_recovery.py.
- Measurement-provenance DET lint — plan_review/det_measurement_provenance.py.
- Impact-aware doc suppression — code_review/workflow_ops.py.

Explicitly rejected/descoped items (split-brain remediation, the criterion demotions) were resolved NO and need no further action. No outstanding approved item remains, so the ledger is closed rather than carried. Any future token-reduction work should open a fresh ticket rather than reopen this one.
